Persist component lineage, paid stages and remaining work. Real aperture, sample retention, contact water, tare drift, wear and capacity constrain subsequent food-assay. No composition or safety certification. Action change/death releases only unconsumed surviving escrow once; consumed parts remain in partial apparatus. Resume executes remaining work; destruction yields conserved damaged salvage. Passive drying/creep/wear continue without owner. New grounded information uses existing shared understanding; construction/mastery has no completion reward.
